Looking at the current `process` function, it handles:
1. "bump" - which uses the maptable to call bump_major/minor/patch/prerelease/build methods on a VersionInfo object
2. "compare" - which calls compare(args.version1, args.version2)
3. "check" - which checks if VersionInfo.isvalid(args.version)

I need to create three separate functions:
- `cmd_bump(version, bump)` - takes version string and bump type (major/minor/patch/prerelease/build), returns bumped version
- `cmd_check(version)` - takes version string, returns True/False or raises ValueError
- `cmd_compare(version1, version2)` - takes two version strings, returns comparison result
